title: Best Pilates Studio Software: Reformer Booking (2026)
description: Pilates studio software compared on published prices and reformer spot booking: Arketa, Walla, WellnessLiving, Mariana Tek, Mindbody and Vagaro.
body:
Pilates studios have a scheduling problem most other studios don't: every class is capped by the number of reformers, towers or chairs in the room, and clients often want a specific machine. On top of that, privates and duets usually carry their own prices. This page compares six tools Pilates studios commonly shortlist, using only each vendor's own pricing and Pilates pages, which we checked on November 14, 2026. If a vendor doesn't publish something, we mark it unknown. We have not used these tools ourselves and we don't publish ratings.

{{table:arketa,walla,wellnessliving,mariana-tek,mindbody,vagaro}}

Reformer spot booking: who lists it, and on which plan

Spot booking (also called Book-a-Spot or Pick-a-Spot) shows clients a map of the room so they can reserve a particular reformer when they book. Here's what each vendor publishes:

  • Arketa: its Pilates + Lagree page says clients can "pick their exact reformer or megaformer when they book". It also lists waitlist automation, automatic no-show and cancellation fees, and booking for privates and duets (Arketa Pilates + Lagree). The pricing page doesn't say which plans include spot booking.
  • Walla: Book-a-Spot and waitlists come with every plan, including Core (Walla pricing). Walla's Pilates page says class size is capped at your equipment count, waitlists offer a canceled spot to the next person, late-cancel fees show on the roster, and privates, duets and semi-privates can each have their own price (Walla Pilates).
  • WellnessLiving: its Pilates page says Book-A-Spot lets clients reserve a Reformer, Tower or Chair, and that waitlisted clients are promoted automatically (WellnessLiving Pilates). Book-a-Spot asset reservations also appear among the key features on the pricing page.
  • Mariana Tek: its homepage says you can "enable pick-a-spot and create custom floor plans for reformers and megaformers." Its pricing page names Pilates (Lagree, Megaformer and mat-based) among its customers' class types (Mariana Tek pricing).
  • Mindbody: Client Pick-a-Spot and room/resource management are on Accelerate, not Starter. Only Starter has a published price; Accelerate is quote only (Mindbody pricing).
  • Vagaro: we didn't find reformer spot booking on Vagaro's pricing page or its Pilates page. The pricing page lists calendar and resource management and customer waitlist options (Vagaro pricing, Vagaro Pilates). Ask in the free trial whether you can book clients onto a specific machine.

What each tool costs a Pilates studio

  • Arketa: Individual is $49/mo billed annually for one team member login, plus a 3% transaction fee on top of Stripe (2.9% + $0.30 in the US). Studio Core, Growth and Suite (unlimited team members, multiple rooms and locations) are quote only. Studio plans renew annually; Individual is month to month unless you choose annual (Arketa pricing). {{aff:arketa|Visit Arketa}}
  • Walla: plans start at $299/mo per location, with unlimited users on every plan. Pro adds a branded studio app and two-way texting, and Scale adds the Retention Suite and Walla Voice. Pro and Scale are quote only. The pricing page says there are no booking fees for your clients (Walla pricing). {{aff:walla|Visit Walla}}
  • WellnessLiving: Starter is $69/mo for one staff member, Business is $199/mo with unlimited staff, and BusinessPro is $349/mo with a white-label Achieve client app. Annual billing brings those to $62, $179 and $314/mo. On November 14 the pricing page also showed a promo of 80% off for two months on Business and BusinessPro. Data migration is free; card rates aren't published (WellnessLiving pricing). {{aff:wellnessliving|Visit WellnessLiving}}
  • Mariana Tek: no published prices; you book an intro call. Every plan, starting with Core, includes custom-branded iOS and Android apps, kiosk check-in and waivers. Payments run through Stripe at Stripe's standard rate, and Mariana Tek says it adds nothing on top. Onboarding typically takes five to eight weeks (Mariana Tek pricing). See Mariana Tek vs Mindbody. {{aff:marianatek|Visit Mariana Tek}}
  • Mindbody: Starter starts at $79/mo per location (North America and Asia) with unlimited users and a listing on the Mindbody app. A new client the app sends you is charged 20% on their first purchase, capped at $30. Pick-a-Spot needs Accelerate, which is quote only (Mindbody pricing). Full breakdown: Mindbody pricing. {{aff:mindbody|Visit Mindbody}}
  • Vagaro: $30/mo for one bookable calendar ($23.99/mo for the first 6 months), plus $10/mo for each extra calendar. There's a 30-day free trial and no cancellation fees. Optional add-ons include a branded app ($100/mo), a check-in app ($10/mo) and live streaming ($10/mo) (Vagaro pricing). {{aff:vagaro|Visit Vagaro}}

Cost at a glance

Published prices only, before card processing:

  • Solo instructor teaching privates and a few mat classes: Vagaro $30/mo ($23.99 for the first 6 months), Arketa Individual $49/mo billed annually plus 3% per transaction, or WellnessLiving Starter $69/mo.
  • Reformer studio with 5 instructors, where clients pick a machine: WellnessLiving Business $199/mo (unlimited staff; Book-a-Spot listed on the pricing page) or Walla Core $299/mo per location (Book-a-Spot on every plan). Mindbody's Pick-a-Spot needs Accelerate, Arketa Studio is quote only, and Mariana Tek is quote only.
  • Studio that wants its own branded app: Mariana Tek includes one on every plan (quote only). WellnessLiving BusinessPro is $349/mo. Vagaro is $30/mo plus a $100/mo branded app add-on. Walla Pro, Arketa Studio Suite and Mindbody (an add-on on Accelerate and Ultimate) are quote only.

Which Pilates studio software to shortlist

If you run a reformer studio and want to see the price before a sales call, WellnessLiving and Walla are the two here that publish a price and list spot booking. WellnessLiving starts lower, but its $69 Starter plan covers only one staff member. Walla is per location with unlimited users. Arketa fits solo instructors (Individual, $49/mo billed annually) and lists reformer spot booking on its Pilates page. Mariana Tek is built for boutique brands that want their own app and can wait five to eight weeks for onboarding. Mindbody's draw is its consumer app listing. Vagaro has the lowest entry price, but we couldn't confirm reformer spot booking from its public pages.

Before you switch, check four things in a demo or trial: (1) can class capacity follow your machine count, (2) do waitlisted clients get promoted automatically, (3) are late-cancel and no-show fees charged automatically, and (4) can privates and duets be priced separately from group classes. Our software buying checklist covers the rest.

faq: What is the best Pilates studio software?

No single pick wins on published data alone. As of November 14, 2026, Arketa, Walla, WellnessLiving and Mariana Tek all list reformer spot booking on their own pages. Of those, only Walla (from $299/mo per location) and WellnessLiving (from $69/mo, or $199/mo for unlimited staff) publish prices. Arketa publishes only its $49/mo Individual plan (billed annually). Mariana Tek is quote only. Mindbody has Pick-a-Spot on its quote-only Accelerate plan.
Which Pilates software lets clients pick a specific reformer?

Arketa (spot booking for reformers and megaformers), Walla (Book-a-Spot on every plan), WellnessLiving (Book-A-Spot for Reformer, Tower or Chair), Mariana Tek (pick-a-spot floor plans for reformers and megaformers) and Mindbody (Client Pick-a-Spot on Accelerate and Ultimate). We didn't find reformer spot booking on Vagaro's pricing or Pilates pages (vendor pages checked 2026-11-14).
How much does Pilates studio software cost?

Published starting prices checked November 14, 2026: Vagaro $30/mo for one bookable calendar ($23.99 for the first 6 months), Arketa Individual $49/mo billed annually plus a 3% transaction fee, WellnessLiving Starter $69/mo (one staff) or Business $199/mo (unlimited staff), Mindbody Starter from $79/mo per location, and Walla from $299/mo per location. Mariana Tek doesn't publish prices. Card processing is extra on all of them.
Can Pilates software price privates and duets separately?

Walla's Pilates page says privates, duets and semi-privates can each be priced their own way. Arketa's Pilates + Lagree page lists booking for group classes, privates and duets. WellnessLiving, Mindbody, Vagaro and Mariana Tek list appointments or private sessions alongside classes. Confirm duet pricing in a demo.
Is Mindbody good for Pilates studios?

Mindbody Starter (from $79/mo per location) includes unlimited users and a listing on the Mindbody app. Client Pick-a-Spot and room/resource management are on Accelerate, which doesn't have a published price. A new client the Mindbody app sends you is charged 20% on their first purchase, capped at $30 (mindbodyonline.com/business/pricing).
